outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle (frames 0–80, image and left_ego_image), then closes its fingers around the handle (frames 81–90, wrist_image). It pulls the drawer outward during frames 102–122; the extended drawer and exposed side are visible in image and left_ego_image, confirming opening. No failed acquisition, harmful contact, or displacement of unrelated tabletop objects is visible.
